discovery_policy: Topics are curated before classification. Automated systems may assign existing topics but must not create, rename, merge, split, or remove topics.
relationship_to_issues: Topics are an independent report-level classification system, not parents of extracted issues. Existing precise issues remain unchanged.

facets.concern: A recurring prevention concern, failure or organisational weakness.
facets.setting: A service, institution or physical operating context.
facets.circumstance_condition: A material circumstance, behaviour or health condition relevant to the report.
facets.population: A population whose characteristics or position are materially relevant to the report.

topics.label: Access to care, capacity and waiting times
topics.description: Delayed, unavailable or inaccessible care, including service thresholds, queues, capacity constraints and barriers to timely provision.

topics.label: Bed shortages
topics.description: Lack of suitable inpatient beds, delayed admission or transfer, inappropriate placement, or other safety effects of bed scarcity.

topics.label: Clinical assessment and decision-making
topics.description: Inadequate, delayed or incomplete clinical assessment, review, formulation or clinical decision-making.

topics.label: Diagnosis and test-result management
topics.description: Missed, delayed or incorrect diagnosis and failures to request, review, communicate or act on investigations and results.

topics.label: Recognition and escalation of deterioration
topics.description: Failure to recognise warning signs, respond to deterioration or escalate a person for timely clinical attention.

topics.label: Monitoring and observation
topics.description: Inadequate observation, physiological monitoring, surveillance, checking or response to monitoring information.

topics.label: Treatment and care delivery
topics.description: Treatment, nursing, personal care or other planned care that was inadequate, delayed, omitted or not delivered as intended.

topics.label: Medication safety
topics.description: Unsafe prescribing, dispensing, administration, omission, storage, reconciliation, monitoring or review of medicines.

topics.label: Risk assessment and safety planning
topics.description: Failure to identify, assess, communicate or manage risk, or to create and implement an adequate safety plan.

topics.label: Care planning, coordination and continuity
topics.description: Fragmented or uncoordinated care, unclear ownership, inadequate care planning, or loss of therapeutic and service continuity.

topics.label: Communication with patients and families
topics.description: Inadequate communication, explanation, consultation or response involving patients, relatives, carers or advocates.

topics.label: Professional and inter-agency communication
topics.description: Inadequate communication or information exchange within or between teams, professions, services and organisations.

topics.label: Referral, follow-up and non-attendance
topics.description: Missed, delayed, rejected or misdirected referrals; absent follow-up or recall; and unsafe responses to missed contact or disengagement.

topics.label: Handover, transfer and discharge
topics.description: Unsafe or incomplete transfer of care, responsibility or information between people, teams, organisations, settings or home.

topics.label: Records, documentation and information access
topics.description: Incomplete, inaccurate, unavailable, inaccessible or unreviewed records and failures to create or maintain required documentation.

topics.label: Staff shortages and workload pressure
topics.description: Insufficient staffing, vacancies, unstable staffing, excessive caseloads or workload pressure that contributed to risk.

topics.label: Training, competence and supervision
topics.description: Inadequate training, induction, knowledge, practical competence, professional support or supervision.

topics.label: Safeguarding, consent and legal protections
topics.description: Safeguarding failures and inadequate consent, capacity, best-interests, reasonable-adjustment or other legal-protection processes.

topics.label: Emergency response and resuscitation
topics.description: Delayed, unavailable or inadequate emergency action, first aid, rescue, resuscitation or urgent response.

topics.label: Restraint and restrictive interventions
topics.description: Risks or failures involving physical restraint, prone restraint, rapid tranquillisation, seclusion or other restrictive interventions.

topics.label: Equipment, digital systems and alarms
topics.description: Faulty, unavailable, unsuitable or poorly maintained equipment, software, interoperability, alerts, alarms or digital workflows.

topics.label: Environment, infrastructure and safety design
topics.description: Unsafe layouts, structures, facilities, maintenance, visibility, access controls or other physical and environmental design features.

topics.label: Falls and trip hazards
topics.description: Accidental falls, fall-prevention failures and environmental trip hazards. Do not assign solely for intentional jumping or falling connected with suicide or self-harm.

topics.label: Policies, procedures and regulatory oversight
topics.description: Missing, inadequate, outdated, unclear or unimplemented policies and procedures, and weaknesses in regulation or oversight.

topics.label: Incident investigation, governance and organisational learning
topics.description: Inadequate incident review, investigation, audit, governance, implementation of recommendations or learning from previous events and deaths.

topics.label: Public information, warnings and product labelling
topics.description: Missing, unclear or inadequate safety information, public warnings, instructions, signage or product labelling.

topics.label: Online hazards
topics.description: Harm linked to online content, platforms, services, sales or access to dangerous information or products; excludes internal operational IT failures.

topics.label: Suicide and self-harm
topics.description: Suicidal behaviour, suspected suicide, self-injury or missed opportunities to prevent suicide or self-harm.

topics.label: Maternity, perinatal and neonatal care
topics.description: Pregnancy, childbirth, maternity services, newborn care and early postnatal or neonatal safety.

topics.label: Prisons and criminal-justice supervision
topics.description: Prison custody, prison healthcare, release planning, probation, offender management or other criminal-justice supervision.

topics.label: Care homes
topics.description: Residential or nursing home care, including care delivery, supervision, safeguarding and coordination with external services.

topics.label: Substance use
topics.description: Alcohol or other drug use, dependence, withdrawal, overdose, relapse, treatment or service access materially relevant to the report.

topics.label: Road traffic and highways
topics.description: Road users, vehicles, traffic operations, junctions, signage, maintenance and highway design; excludes rail settings.

topics.label: Rail settings
topics.description: Railways, trains, stations, tracks, platforms, level crossings and rail operations.

topics.label: Children and young people
topics.description: Babies, children, adolescents and young adults where age-specific vulnerability, services or duties are materially relevant.

topics.label: Older people
topics.description: Older people where ageing, frailty, multimorbidity or age-related service needs are materially relevant.

topics.label: Learning disability
topics.description: People with a learning disability where related health inequalities, communication needs, reasonable adjustments or service failures are relevant.

topics.label: Autism
topics.description: Autistic people where sensory, communication, support, reasonable-adjustment or service needs are materially relevant.

topics.label: Ambulance services
topics.description: Ambulance call handling, triage, dispatch, response, on-scene care, conveyance and handover.

topics.label: Sepsis
topics.description: Sepsis recognition, investigation, escalation, treatment, monitoring or prevention materially relevant to the report.
